The existing complete proof does not remove that expository need.

diagram_math_checks.evidence: With L_j=mathcal L(lambda_j), Phi:M -> direct_sum_j V(lambda_j) is the module isomorphism of Statement (ii) and step 6.1. Its restriction maps L isomorphically onto direct_sum_j L_j. Since Phi(qL)=q Phi(L), it induces barPhi:L/qL -> direct_sum_j(L_j/qL_j), a Q-linear isomorphism. The bottom restriction barPhi|B maps the basis set B bijectively onto the tagged disjoint union of canonical basis sets by Statement (ii), not onto the entire residue vector space.

diagram_math_checks.check: Vertical maps and all three commuting squares
diagram_math_checks.evidence: The top vertical arrows are L -> M and direct_sum L_j -> direct_sum V(lambda_j), both inclusions, and Phi composed with the left inclusion equals the right inclusion composed with Phi|L. Middle vertical arrows pi:L -> L/qL and pi':direct_sum L_j -> direct_sum(L_j/qL_j) are reduction modulo q, and barPhi pi = pi' Phi|L by the definition of the induced map. Bottom arrows are B -> L/qL and disjoint_union mathcal B(lambda_j) -> direct_sum(L_j/qL_j), inclusions of the given basis sets; barPhi composed with the left inclusion equals the right inclusion composed with barPhi|B. Crystal-basis Definition (iv)-(vi) supplies these basis inclusions and induced operators.

Step 7.1, using F4-F5 and def-highest-weight-element-and-connected-highest-weight-crystal, identifies each C_j=barPhi^{-1}(mathcal B(lambda_j)) as a full connected component with unique top b_j=barPhi^{-1}(b_lambda_j) and C_j=F(b_j). That supplier defines F(b) as nonzero iterated lowering images. def-crystal-graph-epsilon-phi-and-weight and crystal-basis Definition (vi) orient each coloured edge b -> tilde f_i b. The caption asserts preservation only for existing nonzero lowering edges; it does not assert an arbitrary shape, a fixed number of edges or two distinct colours at a top.

Statement Choice paragraph and step 6.1 explicitly allow J infinite; only finitely many summands contribute to any fixed label-weight space. All diagram sums/unions use j in J with no finite component cartoon, and the caption restates the exact local condition.
